(2) CODES. P5/U4/N4/NEG/ERR/MASKED and the 'v' suffix keep their R18-A1 meaning. Added here:
  (a) UP TEST PROCEDURE.
    - S0 = the newest LB download (ladder watcher, E10 hourly or manual), taken after our previous completion and before this ref's first terminal poll.log header.
    - S1 = the first LB download after that header in which OUR row's LastSubmissionDate equals this ref's submit time. LastSubmissionDate is the submit time of our latest SCORED file (05:28:22 at 17:31Z, with 45/46 pending), so this proves S1 contains the ref.
    - UP = >= 1 TeamId ranked above us in S0 and below us in S1. A team's public best never drops, so only our improvement can do this.
    - If S1 already shows a LATER ref of ours (co-completion), the UP goes to the higher display. At equal displays both refs are MASKED.
  (b) RELATIVE TO OUR BEST. B = our LB display at S0.
    - display > B -> P-code by display (P5 = 0.955, P6 = >= 0.956);
    - display = B with an UP -> U<B> (U4 at 0.954, U5 at 0.955);
    - display = B with 0 passed -> N<B>;
    - 0.954 <= display < B -> MASKED (the lever is unread, not closed);
    - display <= 0.953 -> NEG (below every base, whatever B is).
  (c) BLIND. Log k = the number of teams above us inside our display block at S0 (17:31Z: k = 5, position 6 of 114). If k = 0, a 0-passed read is BLIND, not N4, and the lever stays open, as with MASKED.
  (d) LEVER STATE.
    - + = a P-code or a U-code;
    - 0 = an N-code with k >= 1, not MASKED, no 'v';
    - ? = MASKED, BLIND, 'v' or ERR;
    - - = NEG.

findings.what:
Outcome arithmetic behind the table (MODEL ESTIMATE).
exp70b sits ~5e-5 below the 0.9545 edge with k = 5 teams in between, so a U4 needs a delta of about (1e-5, 5e-5).
- CI, round-18 prior N(+0.0004, 0.002): P(U4) ~1%; P(P5) ~0.4-0.55 before the ~0.1 no-op/partial-coverage risk (round-18 judge: 0.35-0.40); P(NEG, delta < -0.00095) ~0.25; P(N4) ~0.2.
- SEC, median ~-0.0005, sd ~0.002: P5 ~0.2-0.3, NEG ~0.3.
So CI/SEC reads are in practice P5/N4/NEG, and U4 matters only for small division levers (sd ~2e-4). For CI/SEC, N4 means 'not positive enough to stack', which is why N4 closes those levers.
Team odds are unchanged from the round-18 judge: P(display >= 0.955 by 29 Sep 19:00Z) ~0.35-0.45, P(>= 0.956) ~0.10-0.15; private gain ~0.
